summary: Implemented the S3 Expires change by reading and editing files only; no tests were run and nothing was committed. Changes: (1) botocore/parsers.py, BaseRestParser._parse_non_payload_attrs: for header members whose shape is named Expires, a parse failure (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError) now omits the key and logs a warning instead of raising. (2) botocore/handlers.py: new handle_expires_string handler registered on after-call.s3; for successful responses whose output shape has an Expires timestamp member, it sets ExpiresString to the raw header value. (3) .changes/next-release/enhancement-s3-expires.json: changelog entry. Not done: ExpiresString is not a modeled member in the service JSON, so it does not appear in generated docs, and no docs-level deprecation notice was added for Expires. The Expires fallback is keyed on the shape name, so it applies to any service with an Expires timestamp header, not only S3.
